dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Sorry to put you on the spot like this, but from where you're standing, is there anything about my voice that sounds a bit off?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not at all, it's positively booming.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Seems like there was nothing wrong with that drink I just had after all. Though my throat still feels a bit sticky...

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: A host's voice is their greatest weapon, so we can't get careless with it.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I can't hear anything wrong with it.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: I see. Well, I guess there's no problem after all.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Any tips for maintaining a healthy throat?

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Exercise more! The trick is to stay healthy.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: You heard that right. The only way to keep your spirits up so you can speak confidently is by staying healthy.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Projecting your voice so that everyone hears it when you're up in a hot air balloon isn't easy, especially when you're competing against the roar of the crowd and the contestants' impassioned cries.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: I get through so much water over the course of a competition that I could even drink the People of the Springs dry!

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Oh, and speaking of which, if you want to keep your throat in top shape, you should drink more water and less unhealthy beverages!

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Do they, then? Well, guess there's no choice in the matter. I suppose we'll have to just compromise on one item here, then?

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: As I see it, drinking water isn't exactly something too sad, but some prefer sweeter things.

dialogues.speaker: Balam
dialogues.text: Alright, then, let's have ourselves a little pick-me-up.
